title: Lovely dishes
text: Lovely dishes. Seller web description says dishes are dishwasher, microwave safe.  Brochure in manufacturer package says to wash by hand. These are lovely crystal dishes, but I don't want dishes that are so fragile I can't put them in the dishwasher.
